dateIdeas.title: Sunset Picnic
dateIdeas.description: Pack a wicker basket with our favorite artisan cheeses, fresh strawberries, and chilled sparkling cider. We'll spread out a soft blanket and watch the sky melt into lavender and gold.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Bring an extra warm cardigan or throw blanket for when the sun dips below the hills.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Paved gentle pathway to the picnic knoll with wooden benches nearby.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Café Date
dateIdeas.description: Spend a slow afternoon trying three distinct cozy neighborhood cafés. We'll order one specialty beverage and one warm pastry at each spot and score them in our little notebook.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Come with an appetite for matcha lattes, cardamom buns, and deep conversations.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Level street entrances with comfortable indoor seating.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Movie Night at Home
dateIdeas.description: Construct a palace out of every soft blanket and fairy light in the apartment. Squeeze inside with warm stove-popped caramel popcorn and binge our favorite films.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Fairy lights, giant cushions, and pajamas required.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Ultra relaxed home floor and couch setting.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Go for a Drive
dateIdeas.description: No strict destination in mind. We roll the windows down, blast the songs we both know every single lyric to, and stop whenever an interesting roadside fruit stand or lookout appears.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Charge phones, download our roadtrip playlist, and pack gummy candies.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Comfortable car ride with accessible viewpoints.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Cook Dinner Together
dateIdeas.description: We tie our aprons on, put on soft acoustic jazz, and roll out fresh tagliatelle dough from scratch. Complete with simmering browned-butter sage sauce, freshly grated parmesan, and wine.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Expect a little dusting of flour on our noses!
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Kitchen workspace with counter stools.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Painting or Pottery
dateIdeas.description: Sit side-by-side behind the potter's wheel or in front of twin easels. We'll sculpt or paint something inspired by each other—no artistic skills required, just pure fun and giggles.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Wear clothes you wouldn't mind getting a tiny smudge of clay or paint on.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Seated ceramic studio stations with accessible wash basins.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Arcade or Bowling Night
dateIdeas.description: Skeeball, air hockey, and cosmic glow bowling. Winner gets to pick the midnight snack and gets a victory kiss.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Bring your competitive spirit!
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Wheelchair accessible bowling ramps and wide arcade aisles.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Stargazing
dateIdeas.description: Drive away from city lights, lay back on the hood or a thick wool blanket, and gaze up at the Milky Way. We'll identify constellations and make wishes on shooting stars.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Thermos of hot chocolate, thick jackets, and star-map app.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Open clearing right next to scenic vehicle pull-off.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Revisit Our First Date
dateIdeas.description: Walk the exact steps, sit at the same corner table, and reminisce about how butterflies were fluttering in our chests the first time our eyes met.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Bonus points for wearing similar outfits or colors from that magical day.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Full accessibility according to original venue.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Try a New Restaurant
dateIdeas.description: Dress to the nines and indulge in a romantic multi-course culinary adventure. Dim lights, soft music, and exquisite desserts.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Semi-formal romantic attire recommended.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Ground-floor entrance, elevator, spacious dining area.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Bookstore Date
dateIdeas.description: Get lost between tall mahogany shelves. We each pick one book or poetry piece that reminds us of each other, tuck a secret note inside, and read our favorite paragraphs together in a quiet corner.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Perfect for a slow rainy afternoon.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Ramps available and cushioned reading armchairs.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Watch the Sunrise
dateIdeas.description: Wake up before the rest of the world, slip into oversized hoodies, pick up fresh morning croissants right as the bakery ovens open, and watch the ocean turn gold.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Set an early alarm and bundle up warm.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Boardwalk path with railing and benches.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Walk Through a Garden
dateIdeas.description: Wander hand-in-hand through lush tropical glasshouses, blooming orchid corridors, and hidden stone archways. A tranquil paradise filled with floral scent.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Wear comfortable walking shoes and bring a camera for portraits.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Paved ADA-compliant garden pathways throughout.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Surprise Date
dateIdeas.description: A curated surprise where every stop is carefully kept secret until we arrive. All you need to do is show up, relax, and let yourself be spoiled.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Wear your favorite comfortable yet cute outfit; all logistics are handled.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Tailored to be comfortable and relaxing.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Bowling Night
dateIdeas.description: Lace up the goofy shoes, grab some nachos, and see who gets the first strike. Loser buys milkshakes!
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Wear comfortable socks for the bowling shoes!
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Ramps to bowling lanes and lightweight balls available.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Movie Theater Date
dateIdeas.description: Catch the latest release on the big screen, share an oversized buttered popcorn, and whisper during the trailers.
dateIdeas.location: Local cinema or indie movie theater.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Book seats in the back row center for the best view and cozy cuddling.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Step-free theater access with companion seating.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Mini Golf
dateIdeas.description: Playful rivalry around windmills and obstacles. Silly trick shots, gentle teasing, and celebratory high-fives.
dateIdeas.location: Outdoor or glow-in-the-dark mini golf course.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Winner gets to pick where we get ice cream or snacks afterwards!
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Gradual paved paths between holes.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Visit an Aquarium
dateIdeas.description: Wander hand-in-hand under glowing blue underwater arches, watching sea turtles, gliding rays, and jellyfish.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Visit during late afternoon feeding times for the best views.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Fully accessible ramps and elevators throughout the aquarium exhibits.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Ice Cream Date
dateIdeas.description: A spontaneous evening trip for our favorite scoops, trying each other's flavors, and walking under streetlights.
dateIdeas.location: Our favorite local gelato or ice cream parlor.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Get waffle cones and try at least one new wildcard flavor!
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Street level entrance with outdoor sidewalk tables.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Farmers Market Date
dateIdeas.description: Morning coffees in hand, browsing fresh fruit stalls, artisan bakery pastries, and picking out fresh flowers.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Go early in the morning for the freshest warm pastries and coffee.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Open pedestrian street area with curb ramps.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Ice Skating
dateIdeas.description: Hold onto each other on the ice, laugh when we wobble, and warm up after with rich hot cocoa and marshmallows.
dateIdeas.location: Seasonal outdoor or indoor ice rink.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Wear warm thick socks, gloves, and a soft scarf.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Wheelchair ice sledges and spectator warming benches available.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Board Game Date
dateIdeas.description: Order warm lattes and spend hours challenging each other to hilarious party games and cozy strategy favorites.
dateIdeas.location: Board game lounge or cozy café corner.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Ask the staff for beginner-friendly two-player game recommendations.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Standard table heights and spacious aisle seating.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Thrift Store Date
dateIdeas.description: Browse quirky vintage racks, pick surprise outfits for each other to try on, and hunt for hidden treasures.
dateIdeas.location: Local vintage boutique or thrift marketplace.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Set a fun challenge limit for the most unique item found!
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Wide shopping aisles with fitting room access.
dateIdeas.author: creator

dateIdeas.title: Amusement Park Date
dateIdeas.description: Ride the fun rollercoasters, share sweet cotton candy, win a prize, and share a sweet moment at the top of the Ferris wheel.
dateIdeas.location: Local theme park, carnival, or seaside boardwalk.
dateIdeas.practicalNotes: Catch the Ferris wheel right as golden hour begins for gorgeous sunset views.
dateIdeas.accessibilityNotes: Paved park paths with ride accessibility passes available.
dateIdeas.author: creator
